trips.lede: Back in the Smokies, and frosted over at sunrise.
story: A solo trip. I drove up Newfound Gap Road before sunrise and hiked to the tower through spruce covered in ice.
The valleys were full of cloud, so the ridges looked like islands. After, I kept going out to Andrews Bald while the frost burned off.

trips.lede: Shenandoah's high point, just off Skyline Drive.
story: Solo, early in the morning. I took the steep way up from Hawksbill Gap: switchbacks, then out onto the rocks by the observation platform.
With the leaves down, the views were open the whole way: the Shenandoah Valley to the west, and Skyline Drive along the crest like it is on this map.

story: An overnight on The Priest. We spent the afternoon on the granite ledge watching the light move across the ridges, and were back on the same rock for sunrise.

trips.lede: A granite summit, two dogs, and a scramble at the top.
story: Up the Champney Falls Trail with my brother, my dad, his friend from work, and their two dogs. The falls were more of a trickle in August.
The last stretch is hand-over-hand scrambling on open ledge, and the dogs handled it better than I did. The About photo is from the top.
